# Relevance and R&D scoring update

24 October 2026, Europe/Warsaw. All current recommended and vetoed scores are recalculated. Historical analyses and exclusions are preserved. The original criteria, deductions, and content confidence are unchanged. Verdict thresholds remain 85 / 75 / 65 / 50; vetoes remain in force regardless of counterfactual scores.

Relevance = `2 × sqrt(distinct sources − 1)`. R&D = `20 × reference pages / total pages`. Both use fractional points and are added once after deductions; totals can exceed 100. Available page counts are used without requiring edition confirmation, as requested. Cross-edition or unconfirmed ratios are estimates with low confidence; unavailable inputs contribute zero and remain unknown.

Reviewed: 4671 recommended and 254 vetoed. Relevance is positive for 1484 works. R&D inputs are available for 1727, including 1243 estimated ratios; 3198 receive the missing-data fallback. 1 totals exceed 100. 0 reference/total ratios exceed one and are flagged without clipping.

The [complete audit](../data/bonuses_261024/scores.json) records every input, both edition identities and URLs, confidence, fallback, prior analysis, all ten contributions, five deductions, two bonuses, and before/after totals. Column names identify criteria; REL is Relevance and RD is R&D.
